audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed with the audited mirror after its corrections landed: level 2, level 6 and the 2+ item stage.
audit.why: sion__yorick.json now reads Yorick / Sion / Sion / Sion / Skill / Sion / Yorick on disk. Level 2 is Sion's because a charged Decimating Smash exists and your pattern does not yet; six is even because both ultimates are map tools; two items is yours because Maiden takes towers he has to leave a fight to defend.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings inverse to the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claimed level 6 'swings lane tempo to you' because his R is not a duel button.
audit.why: True as far as it goes, but Unstoppable Onslaught is 140/100/60s against Eulogy of the Isles at 160/130/100 — his ultimate comes back faster at every rank. Neither six wins the lane; both leave it.
audit.corrected: Six is even: 140s versus 160s, both spent off-lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Glory in Death — the reason this lane is not decided by killing him — appears nowhere on the page. Roar of the Slayer was called 'poke' with no mention of the minion knock-back or the armour shred.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: after dying Sion reanimates with decaying health, and his attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on the target's maximum health. Killing him starts a second fight in which your health stacking works against you and his healing is what ends it — which makes Grievous Wounds a timing decision, not an optional buy. Roar of the Slayer is 800 range and knocks a minion or monster back through you, shredding armour on everything in the line, so he can start a trade without ever entering your 700-range Mourning Mist.
audit.corrected: Have Grievous Wounds up before he dies, not after. His revived attacks heal off damage that scales with your max health. Roar of the Slayer reaches 800 through a minion — he can shred your armour from outside your own range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Dark Procession's wall stops Unstoppable Onslaught, and whether Roar of the Slayer's knock-back displaces Mist Walkers, are not answerable from Riot's text.
audit.why: Both abilities carry terrain and knock-back language about champions and minions; neither description covers walls or summoned units. The missing-interactions entry 'Sion can deny your mobility (Mourning Mist) with Unstoppable Onslaught' rests on Mourning Mist's bogus dash flag and was not written.
